title: Chicken Picante
description: Breast chicken in a cream sauce punched up with Dijon mustard and green peppercorns. Sharp, creamy, and satisfying.

ingredients.notes: to taste — Dijon is already salty

method.instruction: Melt half the butter in a frying pan over medium-high heat. Pan-fry chicken breast for 3–4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and rest on a warm plate.
In the same pan, add remaining butter. Add diced onion and cook until softened, about 2–3 minutes.
Deglaze the pan with white wine. Let it bubble and reduce by half, about 1–2 minutes.
Pour in thickened cream, add Dijon mustard and green peppercorns. Stir and reduce for 2–3 minutes until the sauce coats the back of a spoon.
Taste and adjust seasoning carefully — Dijon mustard and brined peppercorns are already salty, so add salt sparingly.
Plate the chicken and spoon the sauce generously over the top.

notes.title: Mustard Balance
notes.content: Dijon mustard gives the sauce its characteristic bite. Do not overdo it or the sauce will turn bitter. The green peppercorns should be the brined variety from the jar — not dried — for the right texture and flavour. No demi glace is used in this dish.
